note: Decision-readiness register. One row per requirement area from the 2026-11-16 brief. Status is a project status, not an official NFL value, so it carries no source link. A row is 'Met' only when the deliverable exists on this site. The number in 'Clears' is the threshold the gate needs; 'Current' is what the repository holds today.

rows.area: Price snapshots (open and close) for every originated market
rows.requirements: Price-snapshot store
rows.gate: No price feed or licence (F-01, Q-MKT-01); price-data policy not decided (Q-MKT-01)
rows.clears: Licensed feed approved + open and close captured for every originated market

rows.area: Verified results feed and game-level results
rows.requirements: Results feed; game-level results for opponent-aware ratings; 136-game corpus
rows.gate: No results ingest; terms not cleared for systematic retrieval (S29)
rows.clears: 136 completed 2026 games, each row linked to an official source

rows.area: Originated line: side, then total, then moneyline; fair vs market vs difference
rows.requirements: Line origination order and columns
rows.gate: No model output and no market line
rows.clears: 1 model fair line + 1 market line + difference per game, with inputs stored

rows.area: Pre-registration and freezing of rules
rows.requirements: Pre-register each strategy; freeze a rule before data; train/validation/holdout split
rows.gate: Rule text not committed with a registration hash; no holdout seasons
rows.clears: Commit hash per strategy, recorded before the evaluation window opens

rows.area: Leaderboard: signal separated from staking; backtests barred; divisions; control baselines
rows.requirements: Leaderboard rules and divisions
rows.gate: No settled bet ledger (G-14 needs a hash-chained ledger)
rows.clears: ≥1 settled strategy per division with a random and a favourites control

rows.area: Removal-of-luck panel and proper-score ranking (Brier skill, game-cluster lower bound)
rows.requirements: Removal-of-luck panel; rank by Brier skill with lower bound
rows.gate: Sample sufficiency gate G-1 needs settled bets; no probability outputs to score
rows.clears: ≥500 settled bets on ≥250 distinct games over ≥12 weeks (G-1)

rows.area: Demotion gate (live back to paper) and kill switch
rows.requirements: Demotion gate; stopping rule
rows.gate: No live strategies exist to demote; G-15 needs a live ledger
rows.clears: Stopping rule registered per live strategy (G-15)

rows.area: Correlations, published with n
rows.requirements: Correlation values with n; parlay joint-evidence gate
rows.gate: No settled ledger; protocol requires n ≥ 300 per pair from official numbers (F-11)
rows.clears: n ≥ 300 settled games per pair, with bootstrap CI

rows.area: Joint probability for parlays and prop combos
rows.requirements: Keep parlays and combos behind a joint-evidence gate
rows.gate: No directly validated joint probability and no operator void/push rules
rows.clears: A validated joint probability + void/push rules for each combo

rows.area: Model outputs stored as probability plus inputs; 'what would change our mind' field
rows.requirements: Store probability plus inputs; two-sided change-our-mind field
rows.gate: Field absent from the strategy schema (0 occurrences in data/strategies.json and data/signals/strategies.json)
rows.clears: One stored output with inputs and hash; the field present on every strategy

rows.area: Residual vs market published on a schedule
rows.requirements: Scheduled residual publication from day one
rows.gate: No market line and no model
rows.clears: One residual published per schedule slot, with its timestamp

rows.area: Injury report: timestamped series and surprise (not level)
rows.requirements: Store every injury-hub read with clock time; publish delta; daily Wed–kickoff capture
rows.gate: One capture exists (as_of 2026-11-14); no scheduled capture; NFL terms bar systematic retrieval without consent (S29)
rows.clears: ≥3 timestamped reads for the same week with SHA-256 hashes, after the terms decision

rows.area: Injury designation reliability and Questionable calibration
rows.requirements: Score designations against inactive lists; calibrate 'Questionable'
rows.gate: Needs archived reports and official inactive lists for several seasons (Q06)
rows.clears: Multi-season archive matched to official inactive lists (≥1 season)

rows.area: Official inactive lists, Game Books and snap counts
rows.requirements: Actual starters and game-day status from Game Books; snap-count starter proxy
rows.gate: No Game Book or snap-count source captured; route not verified
rows.clears: Official Game Book or snap-count file for each game, linked

rows.area: Depth order source: 32 club depth pages (route a) or snap counts (route b)
rows.requirements: Resolve depth-order source before any backup-deficiency feature
rows.gate: No club depth page verified for all 32 clubs; depth as image or prepended jersey numbers (F-02)
rows.clears: 32 of 32 clubs verified against one route

rows.area: Depth as slot groups; shared and empty slots; no jersey-order or salary inference
rows.requirements: Model depth slots as groups; represent shared/empty slots; reject jersey-order inference
rows.gate: No depth rows captured; replacement tiers are blank by design
rows.clears: Groups recorded with shared and empty slots shown, from an official source

rows.area: Roster / IR sweep of 32 teams before any team-level model
rows.requirements: Run 32-team roster/IR sweep; reserve list so 'not listed' is not 'available'
rows.gate: No sweep; reserve list not captured
rows.clears: 32 of 32 rosters and IR lists captured with dates

rows.area: Roster turnover as a dated event; flag stale depth rows against transactions
rows.requirements: Treat roster turnover as first-class; flag stale depth rows
rows.gate: Cited VR-/VQ- events not located in repo or official sources here (F-22)
rows.clears: Official transaction log captured; depth rows versioned against it

rows.area: Announced-starter evidence field and depth-chart register with date and source
rows.requirements: Announced-starter field; depth register with date and source per row
rows.gate: No dated starter announcement captured (F-22)
rows.clears: Each register row with a date and an official URL

rows.area: Per-team view: starters out, replacements named, net injury count
rows.requirements: Per-team decision view
rows.gate: Team counts exist (Out, Doubtful, Questionable); starters and replacements cannot be identified without the depth register
rows.clears: Starter per slot from the register; replacements named only with a source

rows.area: Matchup deficiency matrix (1st to 4th string)
rows.requirements: Offense vs defense matchup matrix
rows.gate: Depends on the depth register (above)
rows.clears: Register complete for the clubs in the matchup

rows.area: Blank 2nd/3rd/4th-string tracker
rows.requirements: Blank offense/defense replacement slots
rows.gate: Depends on the depth register
rows.clears: Filled only from official source per slot

rows.area: Fixture context and venue of every fixture; dated schedule announcement
rows.requirements: Fixture-context features from published schedule; venue transcription; schedule beside live page
rows.gate: No schedule dataset in the repo
rows.clears: Every 2026 fixture with venue, from the official schedule, linked

rows.area: Stadium roof/surface and NWS hourly overlay
rows.requirements: Roof designation coupled with forecast
rows.gate: No official roof designation captured; NWS is not in this session's egress list
rows.clears: Roof designation per venue from an official source; forecast captured with time

rows.area: Ablations with and without personnel features; chronological holdouts
rows.requirements: Injury/depth ablations instead of fixed penalties
rows.gate: No backtest corpus and no depth data
rows.clears: ≥3 seasons of timestamped inputs, chronological split

rows.area: Shadow baseline (singles only), frozen version and forecasts before kickoff
rows.requirements: Start with singles-only shadow baseline
rows.gate: No model built; no price data for comparison
rows.clears: Frozen model hash and forecast log recorded before kickoff

rows.area: Weekly 'what changed' diff; drift alarms; durable snapshot storage and alerts
rows.requirements: Weekly diff; scraper drift alarm; immutable storage
rows.gate: Two captures in one week only (no diff possible); parser rule conflicts with data (F-20); no storage or alerting
rows.clears: Two weekly snapshots plus an automated row-count and field check that fails the build

rows.area: Week 10 injury tables re-captured and republished
rows.requirements: Re-capture and republish Week 10 counts
rows.gate: Full eight-chunk capture not completed; counts 254/279 not reproduced (F-21)
rows.clears: Row-level reconciliation of all eight chunks against the published table

rows.area: Lions Week 10 game-status cells
rows.requirements: Populate three Lions designations
rows.gate: No defect remains: the current data and the live page both show Out (F-23)
rows.clears: Done when the published cells equal the official page

rows.area: Public analysis layer vs private data layer; terms review
rows.requirements: Split public and private data; read terms first
rows.gate: NFL terms prohibit systematic retrieval absent prior written consent (S29); no decision recorded
rows.clears: Written terms decision recorded per source

rows.area: Questions, suggestions, executive summary, repo review, requirements
